name: dsh-plugin-github-code-theme
description: GitHub Light / GitHub Dark syntax colors for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI — retargets the shell's --shiki-* css-variables theme (used by the sidebar file preview, markdown code blocks, and every shiki-highlighted surface) onto the official github/vscode-github-theme palettes. Light/dark follows the shell's data-ds-dark-theme flag automatically. Pure CSS client plugin.
